en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2539 - Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar narrated from Imam (as)

that a person may anoint themselves with any oil they wish before performing ghusl for Ihram, provided that the oil does not contain:
-	Musk
-	Ambergris
-	Saffron
-	Wars (a type of yellow plant dye).
Imam (as) also added: "Do not perfume your Ihram garments with incense (tajmir)."
